text: Ok this is more clear, so effectively if im understanding correctly, even though i do not see that compile button or etc in this section now or probably have never seen it, doesnt change the fact that it lies dormant there, and could be rendered
resolution: Confirmed the user's understanding with precise terminology: Compile/Trigger/Spawn are not hidden mounted controls in the observed Build-state Section D; they are dormant command records plus a conditional ToolOptions branch that is statically capable of instantiating them when a non-model document and matching active menu state coincide. Actual runtime visibility remains unobserved, but their dormant render path exists and bypasses availability filtering. No code changed.
